routes.retired_because: Finite sampling cannot settle grazing incidence and unbounded excursion time; no such search was executed.

C9000358.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 358 (A three-manifold without conjugate points or nonpositive curvature.; papers: A Three-Manifold Without Conjugate Points and Without a Nonpositively Curved Metric; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/358.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C358_COMETRIC.statement: Actual source family: both inward frames satisfy the explicitly quantified concavity and derivative-domination estimates. Source: cometric.tex eq:cometric-path, eq:end-frames, lem:cometric-bounds. Independently proved in REPORT.md Section 1.

C358_ENDPOINT.statement: The unrestricted intrinsic normal index form has an attained endpoint quadratic, in any torus dimension; nonnegativity is equivalent to p^T(S^-1+M)^-1p <= L. Source conventions: variations.tex eq:index-definition and eq:normal-index-definition; independent derivation: REPORT.md Sections 2-3.

C358_TIMING.statement: Actual returning geodesics obey the symmetric-turn, chord and strict timing bounds uniformly in incidence and duration. Source labels: variations.tex lem:neck-passages; turning.tex lem:turning-time. Proof: REPORT.md Sections 2 and 4.

C358_S_BOUNDS.statement: Spp <= L(1+v0^2), See <= 3C0 L, and |Spe-Lp1| <= 5C0 delta L |p1|, for actual returning passages. Source comparator: turning.tex lem:turning-S-bounds. Independent proof: REPORT.md Section 4.

C358_RETURNING.statement: Source prop:turning-index holds for every fixed source-admissible cutoff and all 0<delta<=delta_*; deep returns have a quantitative energy gap and every return has only the fiber/tangential nullspace. REPORT.md Sections 1, 4-5.

C358_ELEMENTARY.statement: Source variations.tex lem:elementary-passages: all full-line and monotone passages have nonnegative perpendicular index form. Outside this mission certification.

C358_SMOOTH.statement: Source cometric.tex: the endpoint germs join smoothly to the nonpositively curved product collars and compact cores, giving the required closed smooth complete manifold. Outside this mission certification.

C358_ALL_PASSAGES.statement: Source turning.tex prop:passage-index combines all elementary and returning cases. Only the returning dependency is certified by this mission.

C358_ASSEMBLY.statement: Source global.tex prop:global-assembly and lem:index-criterion: complete-geodesic passage nonnegativity and nonpositive curvature off the neck imply no conjugate points. Outside this mission certification.

C358_NO_NPC.statement: Source topology.tex prop:no-npc: the chosen two-piece graph manifold has no smooth nonpositively curved metric. Outside this mission certification.

C358_MAIN.statement: Source introduction.tex thm:main: a closed connected orientable smooth three-manifold admits a metric without conjugate points but admits no nonpositively curved metric. The full theorem remains outside this local certification.
